high_level_description: This image is a social media post from the Instagram account "sanatan_is_alive." The post features a collage of images and text celebrating Bhavani Devi, who is described as the daughter of a temple priest and the first Indian fencer to qualify for the Olympics. Top Section: The top part of the post introduces Bhavani Devi with the text: "She Is Bhavani Devi, Daughter Of A Temple Priest."
